title: Visible Yellow Powder Snow
body:
⚠️ **Visible Yellow Powder Snow – Don't Step In It!**

Have you ever been peacefully walking through the Snow biom only to suddenly sink into a trap you couldn't see? With this texture pack, your survival instincts will finally kick in because your brain will scream: "Don't step there!"

**Why is the snow yellow?** 🤨

There’s an ancient rule of survival: "Never trust yellow snow." We’ve brought this vital wisdom directly into Minecraft. Now, you can spot those dangerous traps from a mile away. If it's yellow, it’s a "no-go" zone!

**What this pack changes:**

Visual Warning: Every Powder Snow block is now slightly yellow, making it impossible to miss against the clean white snow.

Suspicious Bucket: Your Powder Snow Bucket now holds... well, something you definitely wouldn't want to carry in real life.

The "I Regret This" Effect: If you do make the mistake of stepping in it, the freezing screen overlay turns yellow, reminding you exactly what kind of mess you’ve gotten yourself into.
